opening.argument: Judge, look at the offer and the action together. The speaker tells viewers they can earn income on stablecoins while waiting for another entry, then directs them to a link paired with a €20 Bitcoin welcome bonus. The description supplies a separate €20 gift link and a bonus-linked trading link. This is not just a passing mention of market prices: it gives viewers a monetary reason to leave the video and engage with an offer. The evidence does not show the terms behind those links, which makes the reward-led invitation especially important to the assessment.

The description reinforces the invitation with an exclusive bonus, a €20 gift, and bonus-linked trading. Any one of these could be ordinary promotion; together, the threat to purchasing power and the cluster of rewards make the external offers feel like a timely answer to a financial concern. The supplied material shows the inducements and links, but not the conditions under which viewers would receive those benefits.
